Commentary.Commentary: Mushfiqur Rahim was the only one who showed signs of resilience, scoring 26 (highest in this innings) but did not get any support from the rest. Yes, the wicket is not that easy to bat on but the score Bangladesh have posted is way, way below par. It is just a matter of time for Sri Lanka to gun this down. Are we in for some surprise or will it be a stroll in the park for the visitors? Stay with us as the chase is about to begin...

This innings was all about the Lankan bowling which was led by their spearhead, Suranga Lakmal who ran through the top order, bowling 7 overs on the trot and bagging 3 wickets. He was well supported by Chameera who also picked up two wickets towards the end but kept it nice and tight at the start. Also, the Sri Lankans were brilliant in the field, especially Gunathilaka. He inflicted a brilliant run out of Shakib and took a superb catch to dismiss Tamim in a single over. The hosts never recovered from there and eventually got bowled out for their 8th lowest total in this format. Tells you how much are they dependent on the duo of Tamim and Shakib.

A dismal batting show from the hosts to say the least! Not only will Bangladesh be disappointed but Zimbabwe too will be packing their bags to head home as Sri Lanka only have to chase 83 and score 19 runs to make it to the finals.

OUT! RUBEL HOLES OUT! Clever bowling by Sandakan. He tosses a googly, it turns away from off, wanting Hossain to go after it. He does exactly that as he tries to go over long on but holes out to Tharanga there. BANGLADESH HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 82!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gives it a bit of air on middle, Rahman goes for the slog sweep but the ball takes the inside edge towards square leg for a run.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Mortaza perishes in the search for some quick runs. He was expected to come out swinging and he falls in an attempt in doing so! Sandakan tosses it up on middle, it turns back in. Mortaza misses the heave and the ball shatters the stumps behind.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. The umpire has signalled a wide.
The leg spinner on middle, it turns back in. Mortaza tries to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Rubel Hossain walks out at no. 10.

OUT! Second wicket in the over! Chameera is ecstatic! Another bad way to be dismissed but Sri Lanka won't mind. Chameera bangs it in short down the leg side, Nasir goes for the pull but manages to tickle it to Dickwella who pouches yet another one. End of another double wicket over for Lanka.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
In the air... but out of reach! He lands it on a length around middle, Mortaza tries to flick but he gets a leading edge towards cover where the fielder runs in but can't get to it.
Mashrafe Mortaza, the Bangladesh skipepr comes out to bat. Expecting him to look for some quick runs. Time for some entertainment? Maybe.

OUT! The bowling change has done the trick! Chameera gets the reward for bowling well throughout. He bowls it on middle, Rahim who has been so patient till now tries to cut loose. He dances down the track and drags the length ball off the inner half towards short mid-wicket where Kusal Mendis takes a good low catch. The last recognized batsman makes the long walk back in disappointment. Chameera is delighted.
On the pads, worked to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on off, Rahim defends it solidly.
Dushmantha Chameera is back on. My colleague Ricky wanted him to come into the attack and Chandimal is surely listening to him.
Flatter outside off, turning back in. Nasir pushes it to the cover fielder.
Very full on off, driven to covers.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Drags his length back outside off, Nasir guides it through backward point for a run.
Loopy ball on off, driven back to the bowler.
Flighted ball on off, Rahim drives it down with the spin and towards long on for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, guides it through point for a run.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Another ball which is angling into the batsman. He flicks it to mid-wicket once again.
Worked to mid-wicket with the angle.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a run.
Back of a length on off, Hossain defends it.
Flighted ball on off, defended.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floats it wide outside off, Hossain slices it through point for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

HOWZZAT? Not out is the answer to that question! Sandakan floats it up on off, it turns back in sharply. Hossain misses as he tries to flick off the back foot and the ball hits him on the pads. The players appeal, they are actually pleading but the umpire shakes his head. Replays later on show that it would have clipped the leg stump and hence, remain umpires call.
On the pads, spinning away further. The umpire signals a wide.
Floats it up on middle, driven down to long on for a run.
Bouncer! Nasir ducks under it.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Worked to mid-wicket with the angle.
Nasir Hossain walks in next.

OUT! Bangladesh lose their only review! Sri Lanka continue to make further inroads. Perera lands it on a length around off, it jags back in a touch. Abul tries to defend but the ball seems to have taken a faint inside edge and goes to Dickwella who does well to go down to his right and catch it. He throws the ball up in the air in joy and appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Abul walks up to his partner and has a chat and then reviews. The replays roll in and there is a clear spike as the ball passes the bat. Interesting they went for the review because as a batsman you would always know whether you have hit it or not. Another one bites the dust for the home side.
It is all happening out there! Another review, this time it is given out for caught behind. Abul is the man who is in question but he reviews after a chat with Rahim.
FOUR! Another short ball outside off, Hasan tries to cut but gets an outside edge over the slip fielder for a boundary.
NASTY! Perera bowls a short ball, he really bowled that with effort as it shoots off the surface. Hasan does really well to defend it down onto the ground.
The googly, Hasan tries to flick but it takes the pads and goes towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Gives it a nice loop outside off, Hasan drives it through covers for a couple.
Drags his length back outside off, Rahim guides it through point for a run.

NOT OUT! There is a faint inside edge! Sandakan gives it air on off, it turns back in. Rahim seems to have missed it as he tries to defend. The ball hits his pads and goes down towards fine leg. The players make a huge appeal and in the meantime the batsmen take two. The umpire shakes his head for the LBW appeal and signals it as leg byes. The Sri Lankan players after having a conversation opt to review. Replays roll in and it shows a faint inside edge. The on-field call stays and Sri Lanka lose their only review.
Review time! A huge appeal for LBW but the umpire shakes his head. Dickwella seems to be pretty confident and he wants his captain to review and Chandimal goes for it. Looks close though!
Floats it up on off, Rahim sweeps it through square leg for a brace.
Worked with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length on off, defended from within the crease.
Back of a length on off, Rahim defends it off the back foot.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket to get off the mark.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Abul Hasan walks out to the middle.

OUT! Half the side back for Bangladesh. Perera bowls it on a length around middle. Rush of blood for Sabbir as he charges down the track and tries to go over the top. However, the bat turns in his hands and he ends up mistiming it towards mid on. The ball lobs to Madushanka, the substitute fielder stationed there who accepts an easy catch. A needless shot by Sabbir to be honest and Rahim at the other end is gutted as gives him a stare. Nevertheless, Perera gets his first and Bangladesh are staring down the barrel.

This time Dickwella appeals after taking it down the leg side but the umpire is not interested. Sandakan bowls it on the pads, Rahim tries to flick but it goes off something to Dickwella. The keeper appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Must have been off the pads.
Mistimes his sweep to short fine leg.
Shorter in length outside off, Rahim waits for it and guides it down towards third man for a brace.
Shorter in length on off, Rahman pushes it through covers for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Rahim blocks it.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Short on middle, it sits up to be hit. Sabbir rocks back and pulls it with disdain through mid-wicket and the ball races away. Brings up the 50 for Bangladesh!

DROPPED! Not an easy one but you do expect a man with the gloves on to take it. Perera angles it on the pads, Rahim tries to tickle it fine but it goes too close to the keeper, who dives to his left, gets both hands to it but can't hang on. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen take a run. Dickwella should have taken this. How costly will this prove?
Another length ball around off, Rahim defends it solidly. Good bowling from Perera, four dots in a row.
On a length around off, Rahim keeps it out.
On the stumps, defended.
OHHHH! That almost kisses the outside edge of Rahim's bat! Perera bowls it on a length around off, Rahim tries to defend but the ball straightens and beats the outside edge.
Drinks!
Flatter on middle, stays low, something we saw a lot in the last game. Sabbir does really well as he keeps his eyes on the ball and gets his bat down in time to block it.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Drags his length back on middle, Sabbir tries to flick but closes the face of his bat early and hence gets a soft leading edge, back to the bowler.

FOUR! Innovation! That is how Sabbir plays, he will constantly look to score. Sandakan floats it up on off, Sabbir goes down on one knee and nails the reverse sweep through short third man for a boundary.
Flicks it with the spin towards short fine leg for a run.
Gives it air on off, Rahim prods forward and keeps it out.
Time fore spin! Lakshan Sandakan comes into the attack.
Shortish outside off, coming back in. Sabbir makes a watchful leave.
Once again hits it on a length around off, offering no width. Rahim plays it towards point for a quick run.
Back of a length on off, pushed to point.
Fullish on off, driven to covers.
Back of a length on off, Rahim defends it off the back foot.
On a length around off, defended solidly.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Shortish again, Rahman rocks back and pulls it through square leg for a run.
Shorter in length on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Thisara needs to keep it tight here! He concedes his second boundary in his second over. He bowls a half volley outside off, Rahim likes it there, he strokes it through covers and fetches himself a boundary.
The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Another short of a length ball on off, Rahim defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length on off, defended off the back foot.
The batsman has stood up on his toes to play that one.
Good length outside off, Rahman lets it be.
Sabbir Rahman strides out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Lakmal gets his third. He is breathing fire at the moment. Bowls a surprise short delivery and a well-directed one. Mahmudullah though, timed that pull shot to perfection but fails to keep it down. He picks out the only fielder, Chameera, out on the leg side at fine leg who takes a great catch. A well worked out plan by Sri Lanka and Bangladesh continue to fall.
Lakmal errs in line and bowls it on the pads, Rahim misses the flick and the ball hits his thigh pad, goes towards square leg for a leg bye.
On a length around off, defended off the back foot.
Works it around the corner with the angle for a run.
Powerplay 2 signaled! Now, four fielders can be placed outside the circle.
Short ball on middle, Mahmudullah pulls it awkwardly towards deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! That should break the shackles! Mahmudullah shimmies down the wicket also makes a little room. Thisara lands it on a length around off, the batsman cuts it through point for a much-needed boundary.
On a length around off, defended to point.
Nicely played! Thisara offers width, Rahim guides it down to third man for an easy single.
On a length around off, Rahim lets it be.
Shorter in length outside off, Rahim mistimes his cut to point.
Thisara Perera is brought on.
Shortens his length and serves it in the channel outside off, kept out off the back foot towards the point fielder.
Keeps it fuller, angles it in on middle, Mahmudullah bunts it back to Lakmal.
Lakmal is in some pain. He calls for the physio who comes running in with a magic spray. A bit of a delay...
Good length ball on middle and leg, blocked comfortably off the back foot.
Drops it on a length outside off, it comes back in with the angle, Mahmudullah pushes it off the back foot towards point.
Just ahead of a length outside off, Mushfiqur stays back and runs it down past gully for a single.
Fuller and angling in from wide of the crease, Rahim shuffles a touch and nudges it towards short mid-wicket.

A good delivery to end the over! Chameera bowls it outside off, it cuts back in. Rahim does not account for the inward movement and is struck high on the pads. The ball goes down towards third man for a leg bye.
Shorter in length on off, Shakib tries to guide it down to third man but gets an inside edge and onto the ground.
Shorter in length around middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Rahim lets it be.
A bouncer which bounces way above the batsman. The umpire signals a wide.
Back of a length on off, guided to point.
On a length around off, defended onto the ground.
Good length around off, pushed to covers. End of a maiden. This is good from Sri Lanka in a match they have to win. They have their tails up and not giving anything away here.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter in length, guided to point.
Length ball on off, Mahmudullah prods forward and blocks it.
Shorter in length on off, defended onto the ground.
Back of a length on off, Mahmudullah keeps it out.
Length outside off, guided down to third man for a run.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Fullish on off, driven to covers.
Shorter in length on off, Mahmudullah tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Shorter in length on off, guided to point for a run.
Works it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. End of a double wicket over. An excellent one for Sri Lanka and they are on top here.
FIVE WIDES! Lakmal must have gotten carried away here. He really bends his back on this one and bangs it short, it bounces way above the batsman's head, beating the leaping keeper for a boundary.
Mahmudullah is the next man in.

OUT! In the air and a brilliant catch. It is that man, Gunathilaka, once again. He ran Shakib out and now takes a superb catch to dismiss Tamim. Lakmal bowls it just short of a length on off, he gets it to bounce extra. Tamim is surprised by it as he tries to fend it away. The ball takes the handle of the bat and it lobs towards gully. Danushka from point, runs to his right, dives and takes it with both hands. The big fish is out of here. Lakmal gets his second. Both the inform batsmen are back in the hut. Bangladesh in a spot of bother now.
Fullish on middle, driven towards cover for a run.
Mushfiqur Rahim strides out at no. 4.

OUT! A RUN OUT! Excellent fielding effort by Gunathilaka and Shakib who looked really good out there is walking back. Lakmal bowls it on a back of a length outside off, Tamim pushes it towards cover-point and sets off for a run. Shakib is late in responding but goes for it. Danushka from point, runs to his left, picks the ball up and hits the bull's eye at the striker's end. Shakib had already given up as he was hoping for the fielder to miss his shy. Nevertheless, a big wicket for Sri Lanka and they are ecstatic.
Back of a length on off, pushed to covers.
Good length on off, defended.
Another bouncer! Hasan ducks.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

In the air... but does not carry! Good bowling by the bowler. He bowls it on a length around off, it stops on the wicket a little. Shakib tries to drive it on the up. It hits the upper part of the bat and falls short of the mid off fielder who is coming in.

Chameera is generating good pace here! He bowls a bouncer on the body of the batsman. Shakib ducks under it. Dickwella behind the stumps, leaps and takes it. Shakib wants it to be called a wide but the umpire does no stretching this time.
Very full, offering a lot of width. Tamim does square drives it towards third man for a run.
On a length around off, pushed to mid off.
Wide outside off and the umpire stretches his hands to signal a wide.
Comes over the wicket and lands it on a length around off, pushed to covers. End of an action-packed over, two boundaries and a wicket off it.

FOUR! Shakib is continuing from where he left off in the last game! Another fuller length delivery around off, Shakib leans into it and caresses it through extra cover for the second boundary in the over.
Comes around the wicket and shortens his length on off, Shakib defends it.
FOUR! Off the mark in style! Just ahead of a length on off, Shakib strokes it on the up through covers. The fielder from mid off gives it a chase, dives but in vain.
Shakib Al Hasan walks out to the middle.

OUT! Drags it on! Lakmal draws first blood! Not the best of deliveries but Suranga wouldn't mind. He dishes out a full ball outside off, Anamul goes for the booming drive away from his body, a needless shot on a wicket which is not that easy to bat on. The ball takes the inside edge and disturbs the furniture behind. Haque stands there in disbelief and then starts walking back. Another failure for him and Bangladesh are rocked early.
In the zone outside off and on a length. Haque defends it solidly.
On a length around off, Iqbal defends it off the inner half to mid on.
LOVELY BOWLING! Back of a length around off, gets steep bounce on it and also angles it away. Tamim is squared up as he tries to defend but the ball beats the outside edge.
On the pads, Anamul misses the flick, the ball hits the pads and rolls towards square leg for a leg bye.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length outside off, gets it to shape away. Anamul watchfully leaves it.
Short and wide outside off, Haque chops it to point. Already signs of the wicket being slow as Haque could not time that well.
Dushmantha Chameera to bowl with the second new ball.
Ends the over with a couple! Fuller outside off, Iqbal strokes it through covers, does not time it that well but hits it well enough to get two. 4 runs from the first over but a good one by Lakmal.
Another length ball outside off, Iqbal this time did what he could do on the previous delivery, leaves it.

BEATEN! Good lines and lengths by Lakmal. He bowls it just behind a length outside off, angling away from the batsman. Tamim need not play at it but he falls for the bait. He lunges forward and tries to block it but gets beaten.
Good length around off, defended onto the ground.

A huge appeal but not given! Lakmal bowls a full ball around leg, it swings in a touch. Tamim is undone by the late movement as he is struck on the pads as he tries to flick. The Sri Lankan players make a big appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Chandimal thinks about a review but then opts against it. A good decision by the captain as Hawk Eye later on shows it was pitching outside leg.

Bangladesh are underway! Lakmal bowls a full ball outside off, looking for some swing but there ain't any. Tamim needs no sighters, he plants his front foot forward and drives it through covers for a couple.
We are all set to get rolling! Tamim Iqbal and Anamul Haque will open the batting for Bangladesh. For Sri Lanka, Suranga Lakmal will open the bowling. Two slips in place. Here we go...

TOSS - Bangladesh win the toss and opt to bat. They have made one change - Abul Hasan replaces Sunzamul Islam for them. Two changes for Sri Lanka - Danushka Gunathilaka and Dushmantha Chameera come in for Kusal Perera and Nuwan Pradeep.

Pitch Report - Athar Ali Khan says it is different pitch but looks similar to the one on which the previous game was played. Mentions there is a little moisture and it will assist the spinners. Opines run-scoring is not going to be easy. Reckons 230-240 would be a good score on this wicket.

Sri Lanka, on the other hand, are positioned second on the table courtesy a better NRR than Zimbabwe. A win will guarantee a spot in the final but if they lose, they have to ensure that they don't let Bangladesh win by a big margin. The first encounter between the two saw the home side blow away the Lankans completely. Chandimal and his boys will be aware of the fact and it will be interesting to see how they come out today. Stay tuned for the toss which is coming up in a bit.

Hello and welcome to the last game of the group stage of the Tri-series between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka. The hosts have already qualified for the finals with three wins in three games and that too with a bonus point. They would look to continue with their winning momentum today.
